International Outlets Discuss Israel-Diaspora Relations and Security

Multiple international outlets published opinion pieces discussing Israel's relationship with the Jewish diaspora and its security concerns. One opinion piece argued that Israel is focusing on the wrong historical narrative regarding diaspora Jews, suggesting a comparison to Babylon rather than Egypt. Another piece asserted that without Israel, Jews would be vulnerable to the mercy of others. A separate opinion piece criticized Europe for expelling its Jews historically and now attempting to dictate where Jews can live within Israel. Additionally, an opinion piece claimed that Israel only attacks when attacked, citing the Jordanian border as evidence.
